about: What a 100 (or a floor) means, per tracked target and dimension: computed | not_computed | not_applicable, with a plain-English reason. Declared in scripts/lib/dimension_basis.py; scores are unchanged.

reasons.compared: Its root signer set was compared with the other tracked groups it appears in a comparison with (its own chain, and the dated snapshot of other EVM chains where one exists); 100 means no shared signer was found in those groups (contracts of the same protocol count as one group).
reasons.declaration_outdated: The declaration for this target says one thing and this run's own notes say another: treated as not scored until the declaration is reviewed.
reasons.ecosystem_only: Compared inside its own ecosystem only; 100 means no shared signer was found there, not that none exists elsewhere.
reasons.fixed_price_source: Each market's price source is fixed when the market is created and nobody who holds a key on this contract can change it; the exposure is scored on the vaults that choose the markets.
reasons.frozen_reading: This value was last refreshed on 2026-09-23, and the contract has not been refreshed since; it is an old finding kept as published, and whether the contract is retired on chain has not been verified.
reasons.no_allocation_today: Looked: this vault holds no allocation today, so no price path carries money. Its caps are open, so an allocator can fill it without delay; the value follows the allocation and can change at the next scoring run once money arrives.
reasons.no_declaration: No declaration for this target: treated as not scored, never as not applicable.
reasons.no_price: This target neither reports nor reads a price, so there is nothing to measure here.
reasons.no_signer_set: This target has no signer set to compare (no administrator, or no one who can act on it), so there is nothing to measure here.
reasons.no_snapshot: No dated snapshot of another chain's committee exists for this target, so overlap across chains was not checked; the 100 is a placeholder, not a finding.
reasons.no_unbounded_path: Looked: no material price path one hop upstream can move a price without a proven bound.
reasons.not_checked: Nothing shows that its root was compared with the other tracked groups (it is in no comparison registry and no run note says so); the 100 is a placeholder, not a finding.
reasons.outside_rule_scope: This target, or the protocol it governs, reads or publishes prices, and the price-path rule does not cover it yet; the 100 is a placeholder, not a finding.
reasons.own_rule: Scored by this ecosystem's own rule for who can change the prices it reports or relies on.
reasons.price_path_unread: A material price path could not be read in this run; the number is a floor, not a finding.
reasons.price_walk: Scored as the weakest of the material price paths one hop upstream (rule of 2026-10-04).
reasons.price_walk_partial: Scored as the weakest of the material price paths that could be read; at least one other path could not be read, so the true value is this number or lower.
reasons.read_failed: The root or its signer set could not be read in this run; the number is a default, not a finding.
reasons.root_not_safe_shaped: Its root is a contract that is not a Safe (a relay, a registry, an unresolved owner), so no signer set was resolved to compare; the 100 is a placeholder, not a finding.
reasons.signers_not_listable: Its root is a native multisig of the ecosystem and its signers could not be listed in this run, so overlap was not checked; the 100 is a placeholder, not a finding.
